leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic HTML structure with header, footer, main content, and two sidebars.
Apply CSS Grid to define a holy grail layout template.
Configure grid areas to position header, footer, main content, and sidebars.
Implement responsive behavior using media queries to adjust the layout.
Manipulate grid column and row sizing to control content dimensions.
Integrate flexbox within grid items for internal alignment.
Update the layout to handle varying content heights dynamically.
